TABLE.NAME: local_zoomcustom_guard
TABLE.COMMENT: Periods during which the period grading customisation was not active. Used to find activities that may have been graded by the upstream calculation.

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: Null while the condition is still current.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomcustom_occurrence
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per discovered occurrence of a recurring Zoom meeting, with the lifecycle state that decides whether it counts towards the recurring attendance grade.

FIELD.NAME: zoomid
FIELD.COMMENT: The zoom activity this occurrence belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: detailsid
FIELD.COMMENT: The zoom_meeting_details row for this occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, settled, final, expired or flagged.

FIELD.NAME: participantsig
FIELD.COMMENT: Signature of the participant rows this occurrence was last calculated from. zoom_meeting_participants has no timemodified column, so reconciliation compares this instead. Null until first calculated.

FIELD.NAME: settledtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Null until the settle delay elapsed and attendance was cached.

FIELD.NAME: finalizedtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Null until the reconciliation window closed without a conflicting change.

FIELD.NAME: reviewedtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Null until an administrator resolves a flagged occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: reviewedby
FIELD.COMMENT: The administrator who resolved a flagged occurrence.

FIELD.NAME: reviewnote
FIELD.COMMENT: Why a flagged occurrence was resolved the way it was.

TABLE.NAME: local_zoomcustom_attendance
TABLE.COMMENT: Counted attendance per user per occurrence, cached when the occurrence settles. Every gradeable user gets a row, including those who never joined, whose counted seconds are zero.

FIELD.NAME: countedseconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Attendance inside the occurrence window, clipped and merged. Zero for a user who did not join.
